name: csm_enable
label: Launch CSM
help: Native UEFI LegacyBios/Csm16 support, not a separate payload. Disabled by default. Save and reset to apply. Secure Boot is not provided by this build.

name: boot_device_control
label: Boot Device Control
help: With CSM enabled: filter OS boot attempts to UEFI and Legacy, UEFI only, or Legacy only. Firmware tools remain available. Save and reset to apply.
